newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firmer vs weak mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firmer vs weak mark.

text.p: 1440 GMT - The Swiss franc ended firmer against the limp mark but barely changed against the dollar, keeping traders on guard that the German unit could keep sliding amid market fears the single euro currency will be weak.

"As long as there is no signal from the Swiss National Bank, the mark will remain under pressure against the franc. We could be heading for 81.50 centimes," one dealer at a big Swiss bank said. He saw the mark between 81.70 and 82.00 centimes tomorrow.
"This isn't a matter of dollar strength, but mark weakness."
One dealer said the SNB confused traders by refraining from its normal early money market operations until mid-morning. Its addition of liquidity brought the mark off early lows.

"But when you see the mark does not go up you have to sell twice as much," he said, adding it was a bearish sign that the mark kept closing near session lows. * Dollar closes at 1.4740/4750 francs, unchanged from the previous close but up slightly from the opening 1.4723/4728 * Mark ends at 81.98/00 Swiss centimes, down from 82.28/29 yesterday and 82.12/15 at the opening
